events.title: The Harvest Crisis
events.description: A late storm threatens the village harvest. The old records say the reeve rationed the remaining stores, but your knowledge gives the settlement another option.

choices.label: Organize a shared harvest
choices.description: Use tools and coordinated labour to recover more food.

memories.summary: The reeve organized a shared harvest that saved food stores.
The village recovered food through shared harvest work.

choices.label: Follow the historical ration plan
choices.description: Preserve tools and distribute the existing stores carefully.

memories.summary: The village followed the old ration plan during the harvest crisis.

events.title: A Village Compact
events.description: The harvest crisis has changed how the villagers see their future. They must decide whether to formalize shared work or return to familiar customs.

choices.label: Establish shared work days
choices.description: Coordinate labour and pool timber for common projects.

memories.summary: The village agreed to coordinate shared work days.

choices.label: Keep the old customs
choices.description: Avoid a new agreement and preserve existing work arrangements.

memories.summary: The village chose to keep its existing work customs.
